goal: Dump every announcement and gallery post for a chosen child into a self-contained, deduplicated filesystem layout, with idempotent re-runs and read-only interaction with the platform.
preserved_behavior: inso-dumper login and inso-dumper children (foundation spec) are unchanged.
The HttpClient Protocol, HttpxClient transport, BROWSER_LIKE_HEADERS, TokenRedactingFilter on the root logger, the Result/CliError/CliErrorKind machinery, and cli.exit_code_for are all reused as-is.
The Session schema (schema_version=1, phpsessid, user_uuid) and the session JSON file format are unchanged. The sync command does not modify session.json.
The Child.slug rule is unchanged; per-post slugs are derived with the same _SLUG_RE and _ascii_fold so a post slug for the same post is identical across runs.
The CLI exit codes (2/3/4/5/6/99) and their meanings are unchanged. No new exit code is added.

AGENTS.md rules (uv-only, secrets policy, read-only scraping, no commits of children's data) are honored end-to-end. Signed media URLs are short-lived and never persisted to disk; downloaded bytes are the only durable artefact.

phases.name: Domain model: Post, Photo, Attachment, Category

tasks.name: Add Category, Post, Photo, Attachment, Media pydantic models
tasks.description: Create src/inso_dumper/models/timeline.py with the closed set of pydantic models that mirror the spike's API response. All BaseModels use model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid') so an unknown key raises pydantic.ValidationError instead of being silently dropped. The Category enum is IntEnum with ANNOUNCEMENTS = 2, GALLERIES = 3; it owns the api_id integer. Photo.ext and Attachment.ext are @property helpers that derive .jpg|.png|.pdf|... from the original filename with a fallback to the URL path, falling back to .bin. The Post.content field is left as str; the HTML-to-Markdown conversion happens in the writer, not in the model. The Post model adds a dumped_at: datetime | None = None shadow field that the dumper sets at write time and the parser leaves alone on the API path. Module docstring documents the functional-core / no-IO contract.

phases.name: HTTP shell: paginated iterator and signed-URL media download

tasks.name: list_posts(client, session, child_uuid, category) -> AsyncIterator[Post] shell
inputs: foundation spec's http/children_shell.py as a pattern
tasks.description: Add to src/inso_dumper/http/timeline.py an async def list_posts(client, session, child_uuid, category) -> AsyncIterator[CliResult[Post]] that yields Ok(post) per post and yields Err (then stops) on transport / waitingToProcess / non-200 failures — the Result-yielding shape is required to surface Err without raising, per AGENTS.md. A 401/403 surfaces Err(SESSION_EXPIRED, 'timeline_posts') per the design's session-lifetime rule; other non-200 statuses surface Err(HTTP, 'status_<n>'). On each iteration, build the path f'/system-api/timeline/posts?page={page}&categoryId={category.api_id}&child={child_uuid}' and call client.request('GET', path, headers={'Cookie': f'PHPSESSID={session.phpsessid}'}). Parse via parse_timeline_page. Stop when the parsed items list is empty. On waitingToProcess > 0 retry the same page with exponential backoff (cap 30s, 3 attempts); on the 4th attempt give up with Err(CliError(HTTP, subject='waiting_to_process')). The shell does not use the Ok([]) stop signal if waitingToProcess > 0.

tasks.name: download_media(client, post) -> AsyncIterator[MediaItem] shell
inputs: Post model with its Media.photos and Media.attachments
tasks.description: Add to src/inso_dumper/http/timeline.py an async def download_media(client, post) -> AsyncIterator[CliResult[tuple[MediaItemKind, str, bytes]]] (yielding Ok per file and Err to surface failures without raising, matching list_posts) where MediaItemKind is a small StrEnum (PHOTO / VIDEO / ATTACHMENT) and the str is the original name. The function iterates post.media.photos, then post.media.videos, then post.media.attachments. The function iterates post.media.photos then post.media.attachments, GETting src.full / url for each. The signed URL is absolute (host file.inso.pl); the shell passes the full URL as the path argument so HttpxClient's base_url join yields the right request, and the shell sets the Host header. Each media file's bytes are read fully into memory before the yield (per-file buffering; no cross-file accumulation, no incremental hash-streaming in v1). Client errors propagate as Err(CliError(HTTP, 'media_download')). The function does not compute hashes — that is the writer's job (P3).

phases.name: Storage layout, dedup, atomic writes, manifest

tasks.name: dump/layout.py — pure path derivation, content hash, dedup target
tasks.description: Create src/inso_dumper/dump/layout.py (a new package; add __init__.py) with pure functions: derive_post_slug(post: Post) -> str that formats f'{post.created_at.date().isoformat()}-{_slugify(post.title)}'. The _slugify helper imports the same _SLUG_RE and _ascii_fold from models/children.py so the slug rule is shared. post_target_dir(dump_root, child_slug, post) -> Path returns dump_root / child_slug / 'announcements' / derive_post_slug(post). Collision disambiguation (-1, -2, ...) is NOT the layout module's job; the writer handles that because it requires an existence check (IO). dedup_target(dump_root, sha256_hex, ext) -> Path returns dump_root / '_common' / 'photos' / sha256_hex[:2] / f'{sha256_hex}.{ext}'. A separate attachment_dedup_target(dump_root, sha256_hex, ext) is exported for the attachments tree. sha256_hex(data) -> str uses hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(); the layout module owns the hash function so the writer doesn't import hashlib directly, keeping the dedup rule in one place.

tasks.name: dump/writer.py — atomic write, mode 0o600/0o700, symlink-or-copy
tasks.description: Create src/inso_dumper/dump/writer.py with: write_post(post: Post, target_dir: Path) -> CliResult[Path] which creates target_dir with 0o700, writes post.json (serialised via post.model_dump_json() with dumped_at set to datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()), post.html (the raw content), and post.md (best-effort HTML→Markdown; on failure logs INFO and skips post.md). All three files are 0o600. post.json is written first; if it fails, no post.html is written and target_dir is removed. write_deduped_media(dump_root, sha256_hex, ext, kind, data) -> CliResult[Path] writes to the _common/ path with 0o600, atomic (write to *.tmp then os.replace then fsync), idempotent (skip if file already exists with the same hash). link_media_to_post(post_dir, dedup_path, kind, n) -> CliResult[Path] creates post_dir / 'photos' / f'{n}{ext}' (or post_dir / 'files' / ...) as a relative symlink. On OSError (filesystem rejects symlinks), falls back to shutil.copy2(dedup_path, target) and logs at INFO. Returns the per-post path written. The module catches OSError at the boundary and converts to Err(CliError(INTERNAL, subject=<kind>_<op>)) so the core never sees an exception.

new_abstractions.requirement: connect a per-post directory to the shared store, with copy fallback

tasks.name: dump/manifest.py — per-child SQLite read/write

tasks.name: dump/sync.py orchestrator
tasks.description: Create src/inso_dumper/dump/sync.py with one public coroutine: async def run(*, client, session, child, category, dump_root, force=None, log) -> CliResult[SyncSummary] where SyncSummary is @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) with posts_new: int, posts_skipped: int, photos: int, attachments: int, seconds: float. The function: (1) opens a Manifest at dump_root / child.slug / 'announcements' / '.manifest.sqlite'; (2) iterates list_posts(client, session.user_uuid, category); for each Post: if manifest.already_dumped(post.id) and slug is not in force, increment posts_skipped and continue; compute post_slug = derive_post_slug(post), target_dir = post_target_dir(dump_root, child.slug, post); if target_dir exists, pick the next -N suffix to disambiguate; call write_post(post, target_dir); on Err propagate; iterate download_media(client, post); for each tuple compute h = sha256_hex(bytes), dedup_path = dedup_target(dump_root, h, ext), call write_deduped_media(...), then link_media_to_post(target_dir, dedup_path, kind, n); update counts; call manifest.upsert(post, ...). (3) Closes the manifest. Returns Ok(SyncSummary(...)). All Err from inner calls short-circuit the run (no partial dumps). The function never raises; the inner modules own the boundary conversions.

tasks.name: inso-dumper sync <child-slug> [--category] [--dump-root] [--force]
inputs: cli.py pattern from login and children
tasks.description: Add a new typer subcommand sync to src/inso_dumper/cli.py. The command: (1) loads Session via ensure_session_loaded(session_file()); on Err propagate. (2) loads Config via load_config(config_path); on Err propagate. (3) resolves child_slug -> Child by running list_children_shell(client, cfg, session) and matching c.slug == child_slug; unknown slug returns Err(CliError(PLATFORM_CHANGED, subject='unknown_child_slug')) with a stderr message listing available slugs. (4) parses --category (typer Enum-backed option) into a set[Category]; default is {ANNOUNCEMENTS, GALLERIES}. (5) parses --dump-root (default Path('dump')); converts to absolute and creates it with 0o700 (reusing the writer's atomic pattern). (6) parses --force as a repeatable option into set[str]. (7) builds the coroutine _do_sync() that opens HttpxClient(cfg) and calls dump.sync.run(...) for each category, summing the SyncSummary results. (8) prints 'Synced N posts (M photos, K attachments) for <child-slug> in Ts.' to stdout on success; exits 0. The single _dispatch wrapper preserves the foundation's last-resort INTERNAL safety net.
